title: feat(scripts): the JSON-fence gate reads the published READMEs (objectui#12131, phase 2)
body:
Fixes #12131
Clause-②: no

Phase 2 of objectui#12131, the card's last part. Phase 1 landed as PR objectui#12134. This PR widens the scan surface of `scripts/check-doc-json-fences.mjs` from `content/docs` to the published READMEs, so the README examples phase 1 repaired stay covered by the strict authoring face. Triage `6106881179` called this a blind-spot repair inside the ruled programme (objectui#5250), not a new gate.

## What changed

- **One declared scan surface.** `SCAN_SURFACE` in the gate lists three legs in walk order: every `.mdx` / `.md` page under `content/docs`, every `packages/NAME/README.md`, and the root `README.md`. `listDocuments` and the new `surfaceLegs` both read it, and the summary prints it leg by leg with each leg's page count.
- **The README legs come from the doc-gate family.** `PACKAGE_READMES` / `packageReadmePages` and `ROOT_PAGES` are imported from `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs`, the same legs the snippet, fence-language and component-type gates walk. This gate does not spell them a second time.
- **Every leg proves it read something (H2).** Each leg names an anchor page that must contribute a judged node document on every run: `content/docs/blocks/forms.mdx` (unchanged), `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md` and `README.md`. A README leg that collects nothing cannot hand in its anchor, so the run exits 2 (could not run) instead of printing a green over zero READMEs. `analyze` takes `anchors` (default: every leg's anchor) where it took `anchor`.
- **The gate describes itself accurately (H3).** The header's first sentence, a new section on the scan surface, the ANTI-IDLE control text, and the list of what the gate does not read now match the code. The summary's surface line comes from `SCAN_SURFACE`. Its NOT-read line names what stays off. In `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`, the gate's table row and its section now say what it reads. The old sentence that pages outside `content/docs` are not read is replaced by a paragraph that names what is read and what is off.
- **Off the surface on purpose:** `docs/audits/**` (triage: point-in-time records), CHANGELOGs and `.changeset/` (history), `skills/**` (objectui#12135 owns that fence), and READMEs below a package root.
- `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`: the gate test's `ADJUDICATED` entry now reads `README.md`, `content/docs/**` and `packages/**`. The agreement test walks the widened surface. The `notRead: README.md` line is gone, because the root README is now really read.

## H1: which reading of "the published READMEs" (measured at `9b755099`)

Each reading was judged with the gate's own scanner, predicate and the built strict face:

| Reading | Pages | json/jsonc fences | Judged node documents | Newly refused |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| (a, npm-only) root `README.md` plus the root README of every package not marked `private` | 38 | 22 | 18 | 0 |
| **(a) chosen:** root `README.md` plus every `packages/NAME/README.md` (the family leg) | **40** | **24** | **19** | **0** |
| (b) every tracked `README*.md` in the tree | 56 | 30 | 23 | 1: the `object-kanban` `onCardMove` document in `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/README-KANBAN.md` |

- **Why (a), not the npm-only spelling.** `private: true` means "not on npm", not "not published". `packages/vscode-extension` is npm-private, but `vsce publish` puts its README on the VS Code Marketplace, and that README teaches an authored `.objectui.json` node document (a `div` example, accepted). The npm-only spelling would drop that page. The one unpublished page (a) adds, `packages/test-support/README.md`, holds no json fence. (a) is also the leg the three sibling doc gates already walk.
- **Phase 1's three repaired examples are inside (a), judged and accepted:** the root README's Contact Form `form`, its Dashboard `grid` of `statistic` tiles, and the `object-data-table` in `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md`.
- **Nested READMEs do not ship.** `npm pack --dry-run --json --ignore-scripts` in every package directory lists no README below a package root. `@object-ui/components` publishes `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` and `LICENSE`. So `README-KANBAN.md` stays off the surface and needs no fragment marker. The gate's header records this as a dated reading that the gate does not re-derive.

**Classification:** empty. The chosen reading newly refuses no README document, so no README is repaired or declared, and no README file is touched.

## Gate run, before and after

- Base `9b755099`: 184 pages, 227 fences, 185 judged (179 accepted, 6 declared, 0 refused).
- Head `e297f3ad`: 224 pages (content/docs 184, package READMEs 39, root README 1), 251 fences, 204 judged (198 accepted, 6 declared, 0 refused). All three anchors read. `node scripts/check-doc-json-fences.mjs` exit 0.

## Reverse verification (one-time ablation, not kept as a test)

From committed head `e297f3ad`, `node ../objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleted both README legs from `SCAN_SURFACE`. Anchor hits went from 1 to 0, and the blob changed from `62fef312061e` to `6b5e3d8793fa`. Readings with the mutation on disk:

- The gate printed exactly the base surface (184 pages, 227 fences, 185 judged), with exit 0. A content-only surface is green about the READMEs.
- `scripts/__tests__/check-doc-json-fences.test.ts`: **5 failed | 27 passed (32)**. The five that failed are the README tests: the refusal in a package README and the root README; the leg order and page counts; the README fragment declaration; the README anchor control; and the equality with the family's legs.
- Restore was proven by the tool: the blob equals HEAD (`62fef312061e`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. After restore: **34 passed (34)**.

## Tests and gates (all at `e297f3ad`)

Exit codes were captured by redirect-then-read, never through a pipe. Heavy runs went through `os-verify-lock`, and each result below is its `VERDICT command-exit 0` line.

- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-doc-json-fences.test.ts scripts/__tests__/markdown-test-inputs.test.ts scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts`: 3 files, 147 tests passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/__tests__/` plus the two `packages/components` tests that read the markdown ledger: 182 passed, 2 skipped (184 files); 5562 tests passed, 2 skipped.
- `pnpm type-check:scripts`: exit 0. `--listFiles` shows the gate, its test and `markdown-test-inputs.mjs` in the program.
- `pnpm check:doc-types` 0 · `pnpm docs:check-links` 0 · `pnpm check:new-line-citations` 0 (0 new) · `pnpm check:control-bytes` 0 · `pnpm check:doc-fences` 0 and `--self-test` 0 · `pnpm check:test-path-roots` 0 · `node scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --audit` 0 · `node scripts/check-lint-coverage.mjs` 0 · `node scripts/check-vi-mock-override-shape.mjs` 0.
- `pnpm lint:root`: exit 0 (0 errors; 34 warnings, all in files this PR does not touch). `eslint --format json` on the 3 changed script files: 3 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0, "no changeset is owed". No package source and no README changed.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` (4 paths): NOT GOVERNED.
- First measured run of `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts`: red on command parity. My first wording credited the gate's section with a script path that `doc-snippet-types.yml` does not run. The page wording was changed, and the parity ledger was not touched.
- Not run locally: `pnpm check:doc-snippets` and `pnpm check:doc-examples` (they need the full build closure, and this diff adds no ts/tsx fence), and lychee `check-links` (CI-only tool). CI runs them.

## Acceptance notes

- **The refused population outside `content/docs`, re-derived at `9b755099`, not copied:** 16 node documents. 4 CHANGELOG fences and 1 pending changeset are history. 1 is a `docs/audits` record (out by triage). 9 are `skills/**` fences (objectui#12135's surface). 1 is `README-KANBAN.md`, which is off the surface and not shipped. None is on the widened surface.
- **Stale prose noticed, not changed (carrier: none):** the `NESTED_PACKAGE_READMES` docblock in `scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` says `packages/types` lists the whole of `src/` in its manifest `files`, so `packages/types/src/zod/README.md` ships. Today `packages/types` `files` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `LICENSE`, and npm pack ships no nested README. That file is outside this claim.
- **Not changed:** the "What the three doc gates own" coverage table in that same file has no column for this gate. That is outside this claim (carrier: none).
